info.title: pq-dp — diagnostics CLI for PostQuantum.DataProtection
info.description: Diagnostics CLI for PostQuantum.DataProtection. Install as a global dotnet tool: dotnet tool install --global PostQuantum.DataProtection.Cli. Currently supports: pq-dp inspect <path-to-key.xml> — prints envelope routing fields, mode, key id, and byte sizes from a persisted Data Protection key file without exposing any secret material.

commands.name: inspect
commands.description: Inspect a Data Protection key XML file.
